Load configuration files
- location of model drivers, rds files (containing models), tables of parameter estimates and performance metrics, and figures. 
```{r}
read_properties <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  lines <- lines[grepl("=", lines)]  # only keep lines with key-value pairs
  key_vals <- strsplit(lines, "=")
  props <- setNames(
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 2)),
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 1))
  )
  return(props)
}

# *** paleo_config.properties must be in Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026
#location of this script:
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
#get path to this project
base_path <- sub("(.*Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026).*", "\\1", current_path)
#open 
config_file_path <- file.path(base_path, "paleo_config.properties")

# Extract values from config
drivers_root <- config[["drivers_root"]]
rds_root <- config[["rds_root"]]
table_root <- config[["table_root"]]
predictions_root <- config[["predictions_root"]]
mu_sigma_root <- config[["mu_sigma_root"]]
performance_root <- config[["performance_root"]]
figure_root <- config[["figure_root"]]
fire_data_root <- config[["fire_data_root"]]
paleocliamte_data_root <- config[["paleocliamte_data_root"]]
era5_data_root <- config[["era5_data_root"]]
proximity_data_root <- config[["proximity_data_root"]]
```

Alaska polygon and Elevation plot
```{r}
# Get USA polygon
usa <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf")
# Filter to Alaska only
alaska <- usa[usa$name == "Alaska", ]
alaska <- st_transform(alaska, crs = 4326)



# Download SRTM elevation data for Alaska
# Alaska spans multiple tiles so we download by country

# 1. Download and crop
elev <- geodata::elevation_global(res = 10, path = tempdir())
alaska_ext <- ext(-170, -130, 51, 72)
elev_alaska <- crop(elev, alaska_ext)

# 2. Mask to Alaska polygon
alaska_vect <- terra::vect(alaska)
elev_masked <- terra::mask(elev_alaska, alaska_vect)

# 3. Convert to data frame — use elev_masked instead of elev_alaska
elev_df <- as.data.frame(elev_masked, xy = TRUE)
names(elev_df) <- c("lon", "lat", "elevation")
elev_df <- elev_df %>% filter(!is.na(elevation), elevation >= 0)
```


```{r}
p_elevation <- ggplot() +
  geom_contour(data = elev_df,
               aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = elevation),
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.1,
               breaks = seq(0, 3000, by = 250)) +  # contour interval in metres
  geom_sf(data = alaska, fill = NA, color = "black",
          linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  xlim(-170, -130) +
  ylim(51, 72) +
  xlab("Lon") +
  ylab("Lat") +
  ggtitle("(h)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size=11),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size=11),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size=11),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size=11),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "darkgray", size = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "darkgray", size = 0.2)
  )

p_elevation
```

Map Function
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(rlang)

library(ggplot2)
library(rlang)
library(scales)

make_fire_map <- function(data,
                           fill_var,
                           legend_label,
                           title,
                           min_val = NULL,
                           max_val = NULL,
                           viridis_option = "plasma",
                           direction = -1,
                           trans = "identity",
                           elev_data = elev_df,
                           boundary_data = alaska,
                           is_bias = FALSE,
                           bias_palette = NULL,   # e.g. "PuOr" — uses RColorBrewer diverging palette instead of blue/white/red
                           legend_position = c(0.65, 0.16)) {

  fill_var <- rlang::ensym(fill_var)

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = !!fill_var)) +
    geom_raster() +
    xlim(-170, -130) +
    geom_sf(data = boundary_data, fill = NA, color = "black",
            linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE)

  if (is_bias) {
    limits <- if (is.null(min_val) || is.null(max_val)) {
      quantile(dplyr::pull(data, !!fill_var), c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      c(min_val, max_val)
    }

    if (!is.null(bias_palette)) {
      # Diverging RColorBrewer palette, e.g. "PuOr", "RdBu", "BrBG"
      p <- p + scale_fill_distiller(
        palette = bias_palette,
        direction = direction,
        limits = limits, oob = scales::squish, trans = trans,
        name = legend_label,
        guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal", title.position = "top")
      )
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0,
        limits = limits, oob = scales::squish, trans = trans,
        name = legend_label,
        guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal", title.position = "top")
      )
    }
  } else {
    limits <- if (is.null(min_val) || is.null(max_val)) NULL else c(min_val, max_val)
    p <- p + scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = viridis_option, direction = direction,
      limits = limits, oob = scales::squish, trans = trans,
      name = legend_label,
      guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal", title.position = "top")
    )
  }

  p <- p +
    xlab("Lon") + ylab("Lat") + ggtitle(title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "darkgray", size = 0.2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "darkgray", size = 0.2),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), color = NA),
      legend.position = legend_position
    ) +
    geom_contour(data = elev_data,
                 aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = elevation),
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.1,
                 breaks = seq(0, 3000, by = 250),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE)

  p
}
```


Prep data 
```{r}
#calculate bias for lightning prediction
plot_df <- df %>%
  group_by(lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(
    r_s_pred = mean(r_strike),
    r_s_obs = mean(r_strike_obs),
    r_s_bias = mean(r_strike - r_strike_obs), 
    n_s_pred = mean(n_strikes), 
    n_s_obs = mean(n_strikes_obs), 
    n_s_bias = mean(n_strikes - n_strikes_obs), 
    p_i_pred = mean(p_ignite_rate_cal), 
    p_i_obs = mean(fire_count / n_strikes_obs), 
    p_i_bias = mean(p_ignite_rate_cal - (fire_count / n_strikes_obs)),
    n_fire_pred = sum(fire_count_pred),
    n_fire_obs = sum(fire_count),
    n_fire_bias = mean(fire_count_pred - fire_count),
    b_a_pred = sum(total_burned_area),
    b_a_obs = sum(burned_area_km2_total),
    b_a_bias = sum(total_burned_area - burned_area_km2_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Make maps!

strike rate
```{r}
# Predicted strike rate
p_strike_pred <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = r_s_pred,
  legend_label = "Predicted strike rate",
  title = "(a)",
  min_val = min(plot_df$r_s_pred, plot_df$r_strike_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_val = max(plot_df$r_s_pred, plot_df$r_strike_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Observed strike rate
p_strike_obs <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = r_s_obs,
  legend_label = "Observed strike rate",
  title = "(b)",
  min_val = min(plot_df$r_strike, plot_df$r_s_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_val = max(plot_df$r_strike, plot_df$r_s_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Bias for strike rate
p_strike_bias <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = r_s_bias,
  legend_label = "Strike rate bias",
  title = "(c)",
  min_val = NULL,
  max_val = NULL,
  is_bias = TRUE,
  viridis_option = "PuOr",
)

p_strike_pred | p_strike_obs | p_strike_bias
```

strike count

```{r}


# Predicted strike count
p_strike_count_pred <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = n_s_pred,
  legend_label = "Predicted strike count",
  title = "(d)",
  min_val = NULL,
  max_val = NULL
)

# Observed strike count
p_strike_count_obs <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = n_s_obs,
  legend_label = "Observed strike count",
  title = "(e)",
  min_val = NULL,
  max_val = NULL
)

# Bias for strike count
p_strike_count_bias <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = n_s_bias,
  legend_label = "Strike count bias",
  title = "(f)",
  min_val = NULL,
  max_val = NULL,
  is_bias = TRUE,
  viridis_option = "PuOr",
)

# Check percentiles first to pick sensible caps
quantile(plot_df$n_s_pred, c(0.9, 0.95, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
quantile(plot_df$n_s_obs,  c(0.9, 0.95, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
quantile(plot_df$n_s_bias, c(0.01, 0.05, 0.95, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)

# Predicted strike count
p_strike_count_pred <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = n_s_pred,
  legend_label = "Predicted strike count",
  title = "(d)",
  min_val = 0,
  max_val = max(quantile(plot_df$n_s_obs, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(plot_df$n_s_pred, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)) #squish max 95th quantile vale of pred and obs to one color
)

# Observed strike count
p_strike_count_obs <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = n_s_obs,
  legend_label = "Observed strike count",
  title = "(e)",
  min_val = 0,
  max_val = max(quantile(plot_df$n_s_obs, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(plot_df$n_s_pred, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
)

# Bias for strike count
p_strike_count_bias <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df,
  fill_var = n_s_bias,
  legend_label = "Strike count bias",
  title = "(f)",
  is_bias = TRUE,
  bias_palette = "PuOr"
)

p_strike_count_pred | p_strike_count_obs | p_strike_count_bias
```

ignition efficiency

```{r}
    
plot_df_ignite_pred <- df  %>%
    filter(n_strikes > 0) %>%
  group_by(lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(
  p_i_pred = mean(p_ignite), 
  .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_df_ignite_obs <- df  %>%
  filter(n_strikes_obs > 0) %>%
  group_by(lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(
  p_i_obs = mean(fire_count / n_strikes_obs), 
  p_i_bias = mean(p_ignite - (fire_count / n_strikes_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_df_ignite <- merge(plot_df_ignite_pred, plot_df_ignite_obs, by=c("lat", "lon"))

# Predicted ignition efficiency
p_ignite_pred <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df_ignite,
  fill_var = p_i_pred,
  legend_label = "Predicted ignition probability",
  title = "(g)",
  min_val = min(plot_df_ignite$p_i_pred, plot_df_ignite$p_i_obs),
  max_val = max(plot_df_ignite$p_i_pred, plot_df_ignite$p_i_obs)
)

# Observed ignition rate
p_ignite_obs <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df_ignite,
  fill_var = p_i_obs,
  legend_label = "Observed ignition rate",
  title = "(h)",
  min_val = min(plot_df_ignite$p_i_pred, plot_df_ignite$p_i_obs),
  max_val = max(plot_df_ignite$p_i_pred, plot_df_ignite$p_i_obs)
)

# Bias for ignition efficiency/rate
p_ignite_bias <- make_fire_map(
  data = plot_df_ignite,
  fill_var = p_i_bias,
  legend_label = "Ignition rate/probability bias",
  title = "(i)",
  min_val = NULL,
  max_val = NULL,
  is_bias = TRUE,
  viridis_option = "PuOr",
)

p_ignite_pred | p_ignite_obs | p_ignite_bias
```

burned area

```{r}
plot_df_ba_pred <- df  %>%
  group_by(lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(
  b_a_pred = sum(total_burned_area), 
  .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_df_ba_obs <- df  %>%
  filter(lightning_ignition == 1) %>% #only want burned area for lightning-caused fires
  group_by(lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(

  b_a_bias = sum(total_burned_area) - b_a_obs,
```
